articles.title: Bank of America fined $1.2 billion by Treasury Department for anti-money laundering and sanctions laws violations - CNN
articles.description: The US Treasury Department on Tuesday announced it was imposing a more than $1.2 billion fine on Bank of America, accusing the bank of violating anti-money laundering and sanctions laws.
